subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution: The correct answer is **low**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Low: **unhappy. (अप्रसन्न) • Example: Temperature was very ***low ***last night. • The given sentence implies that we feel unhappy when we are unable to achieve the desired results. • Thus, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 1 is **option 3**. **Correct Paragraph:**__ *We believe our value is in direct proportion to the value of our accomplishments. If we cannot accomplish certain results, we tend to feel **(1) __low__** about ourselves. Some of us try too hard and become workaholics and over-achievers. With a few genuine feelings of self-worth, we try to create some and prove that we are somebody by our successes and (2) ______. Because our desire for perfection is so great, we (3) ______ to set unrealistic goals and place unreasonable demands on ourselves. Failing, rather than encouraging us to have realistic aspirations, only leads to a mere punishing round of self-blame and a resolve to drive ourselves harder next time. If we do not finally achieve our goals, we are (4) ______; despite everything we have done, we still feel (5) ______ inside.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **High: **a period of extreme excitement or happiness when you feel full of energy, often caused by a feeling of success, or by drugs or alcohol or a religious experience. (अत्यधिक उत्तेजना या खुशी की अवधि जब आप ऊर्जा से भरा महसूस करते हैं, अक्सर सफलता की भावना के कारण, या ड्रग्स या शराब या धार्मिक अनुभव के कारण) • **Good: **of a high quality or standard. (उच्‍च गुणवत्ता या स्‍तर का, अच्‍छा) • **Better: **of a higher quality or level or more suitable than somebody/something. (किसी अन्‍य से बेहतर, अधिक अच्‍छा या उपयुक्त) 43:Tdd4, The correct answer is **achievements**.
